List datasets inside a SAS XPORT v8/v9 file

Source: R/read_single_xpt.r
ks_xpt_content.Rd

Scans the raw bytes of a SAS Transport Version 8 file for member (MEMBV8) headers and returns the byte range of each member.

Usage

ks_xpt_content(file, chunk_size = 5L * 80L * 1024L)

Arguments

file

Path to a .xpt or .v9xpt file.

chunk_size

Number of raw bytes to read per pass. Default 5 * 80 * 1024.

Value

A named list; each element corresponds to one dataset and contains a named integer vector c(start = <1-based pos>, stop = <1-based pos>).

Details

The file is read in chunks of chunk_size bytes (default approximately 400 KB). A MEMBV8 header that spans two adjacent chunks would not be detected; this is exceedingly unlikely for practical SDTM files.

See also

ks_extract_single_xpt, ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## content <- ks_xpt_content("path/to/study.xpt")
## names(content)          # dataset names (lower-case)
## content[["ae"]]         # byte range for the AE member
} # }
